Measurement distributions and variability

Each participant-variable bucket with a non-missing mean counts as one measurement, whether it contains one or five observations. Missing means are excluded; GPS coordinates are included. Reader date defaults apply when loading.

Total by variable

Overview: original scale

All participants and dates are pooled. Each histogram uses the five-minute means, with one contribution per observed bucket and no weighting by n. Axes vary by variable; values retain their original units. No outlier thresholds are applied.

Focused views

Log scale

uvb, light, pm* and pc*: log(1 + x) scale, retaining zeros and extremes.

Blood pressure

1 mmHg bins, retaining the full range.

Changes between consecutive buckets

delta is the current mean minus the previous mean for the same participant, source and variable. Only pairs exactly five minutes apart are included; missing means and longer gaps are excluded. Absolute changes describe transition size, in each variable’s original units, and cannot be ranked directly across units.

Daily difference

max - min within each participant-variable day. Minimum and maximum are paired by source, participant, date and variable. Sleep and missing pairs are excluded; no minimum coverage threshold is applied. Daily and hourly differences describe ranges within different window lengths, not transitions between windows.
